cfr-385-11.title: 37 CFR 385.11: Royalty rates (Subpart B, physical phonorecords, permanent downloads, ringtones)
cfr-385-11.support: (a)(1) 2026 rate 13.1 cents or 2.52 cents per minute, whichever is larger; (a)(2) annual CPI-U adjustment; (b) ringtone 24 cents; (c) bundles. LII lists last amendment 90 FR 55045, Dec. 1, 2025.
cfr-385-11.edition: Mirror of the eCFR text; the eCFR page itself is script-driven and could not be read automatically

cfr-385-21.title: 37 CFR 385.21: Royalty rates and calculations (Subpart C, interactive streaming and limited downloads)
cfr-385-21.support: Table 1 to (b)(1): 2023 15.1, 2024 15.2, 2025 15.25, 2026 15.3, 2027 15.35 percent of service provider revenue. LII amendment note: 87 FR 80458 (30 Dec 2022), as amended 89 FR 19274.

fr-2025-21695.title: Cost of Living Adjustment to Royalty Rates and Terms for Making and Distributing Phonorecords
fr-2025-21695.support: Adjusted 2026 rates 13.1 cents per work and 2.52 cents per minute; CPI-U 324.800 against base 298.012; applies 1 January to 31 December 2026.

fr-2022-27237.title: Determination of Royalty Rates and Terms for Making and Distributing Phonorecords (Phonorecords IV)
fr-2022-27237.support: Regulatory text, 37 CFR 385.11(a)(1): for 2023, 12.0 cents or 2.31 cents per minute of playing time or fraction, whichever is larger. Docket 21-CRB-0001-PR (2023-2027).

fr-2023-28075.title: Cost of Living Adjustment to Royalty Rates and Terms for Making and Distributing Phonorecords; Correction
fr-2023-28075.support: The adjusted rates for 2024 are 12.4 cents per work and 2.38 cents per minute. Corrects the 12 Dec 2023 notice (88 FR 86058, doc 2023-27290), which gave 2.39 cents per minute and omitted the CPI-U workings (307.671).

fr-2024-27819.title: Cost of Living Adjustment to Royalty Rates and Terms for Making and Distributing Phonorecords
fr-2024-27819.support: The adjusted rates for 2025 are 12.7 cents per work and 2.45 cents per minute. Dated 22 Nov 2024.
